items.item: The ten applications form one recognisable cooperative system through consistent master treatment, typography and branch-name hierarchy; composition may adapt to each application and fascia envelope.
Market Green and River Lane remain clearly identifiable through their written names, which provide the clearest branch distinction while supporting cues remain outside the master.

Branch-specific departments and opening hours remain correctly assigned across the system, while the cooperative statement, welcome wording and sample membership information remain shared where required.

requirementChecks.criteria: Read the original file properties: Format: presentation document; at least eight actual pages. Stage: final.

The specification occupies one page and defines the complete supplied master, proportional scaling on a light solid background, branch cues outside the mark, and nominal ink #244E3D. It assigns 4800 × 800 mm to Market Green and 2400 × 600 mm to River Lane, records each branch's ordered department list, and establishes an actionable branch-name hierarchy. Omitted facts, swapped assignments or a hierarchy too vague to apply fail.

Each document explicitly repeats the nominal ink code, both physical fascia dimensions with their correct branch assignments, and the hierarchy established in the specification. Equivalent dimension notation and paraphrased hierarchy explanations are acceptable; missing facts or contradictions fail. Assess the specification as the governing source without inferring production chronology from finished files.

The visible fascia design envelopes represent Market Green's 4800 × 800 mm surface at a 6:1 proportion and River Lane's 2400 × 600 mm surface at 4:1, consistent with the supplied constraint drawing. Both apply the specification's branch-name hierarchy. Artwork may adapt spacing and placement to each envelope; swapped envelopes, materially incorrect proportions or conflicting hierarchy fail. Exact raster pixel counts are not assessed.

Each artwork shows the complete upright basket-and-wordmark master matching the supplied identity source, with original lettering, symbol, arrangement, proportions and deep-green ink appearance. Proportional resizing and repositioning are allowed. The mark sits on a light solid field and branch cues remain outside its visible bounds. Cropping, redrawing, stretching, recolouring, rearranging or inserting branch cues into the mark fails; ordinary rendering variation around nominal #244E3D is acceptable.

Inspect all reproduced application examples for preservation of the complete master and separation of branch cues. Scaling an entire example to fit a page is allowed; altered lettering, missing symbols, distorted proportions, changed ink or cues crossing into the master fail. Presentation coverage is assessed across the document, without requiring a logo on every page.

Every application visibly identifies its assigned branch using the full words Market Green or River Lane. Capitalisation and line breaks may vary, and colour or symbols may accompany the name. Missing names, swapped names or substitution with MG or RL alone fail.

For each application type, both branch examples retain their correct full branch names and the relative emphasis and placement principles defined in the specification. Whole-example scaling and application-specific spacing are acceptable. Reversing the hierarchy, mislabelling a branch or using incompatible hierarchy rules fails.

Read each directory in its intended reading order. Market Green must contain Fresh produce, Bread & dairy, Pantry staples and Household refills, in that sequence; River Lane must contain the first three only, in the same sequence. Capitalisation, line wrapping and accompanying symbols may vary. Missing, duplicated, reordered or incorrectly assigned departments fail.

Every department reference agrees with the fixed branch records, including Household refills belonging only to Market Green. Complete department lists and reproduced directories preserve the recorded order. Explanatory text may mention a subset without restating a full directory, but assigning an unavailable department to River Lane or changing a directory's list fails.

Both bags visibly carry Good food. Shared ownership. Both sample card fronts show Cooperative member and Member 0042. Both windows show Everyone is welcome. Membership is optional. and daily opening hours assigned correctly: 08:00–20:00 for Market Green and 09:00–19:00 for River Lane. Capitalisation and line breaks may vary; equivalent unambiguous English time formats are permitted. Missing or changed words, an incorrect sample number, omitted daily coverage or swapped hours fail. Bag fronts must be presented as flat artwork.

Read the bag, membership-card and window examples for both branches. They retain the required cooperative statement, membership heading, sample number and welcome sentence, with each window's correct daily hours. Capitalisation, line breaks and equivalent unambiguous English time formats may vary. Missing copy, substitutions or contradictory branch records fail.

The guide contains four pages, explains master placement and branch-name hierarchy, identifies both branch-specific fascia sizes, and includes Market Green and River Lane examples for fascias, directories, bag fronts, membership card fronts and window notices. Page layout and grouping are flexible; an absent topic, missing branch/type example or incorrect page count fails.

Review the entire video and its duration metadata. It runs for 10 seconds, allowing normal frame-duration rounding, presents both branch fascias together as a pair, then both directories as a pair, and concludes with both bag fronts and a readable Good food. Shared ownership. Transitions and animation style may vary. Missing partners, reordered application stages, a materially different duration or an absent ending statement fail.

requirementChecks.criteria: The presentation visibly incorporates identifiable material from the specification and application guide and reproduces every one of the ten delivered application artworks. Examples may be scaled, grouped or placed within presentation layouts while retaining their design and public content. A missing source, text-only mention of an artwork or substitution of a different design fails.

Count at least eight presentation pages and verify inclusion of the specification facts, examples identifiable in the four-page guide, and three identifiable still frames matching the delivered video. Page organisation is flexible, and frames may share a page. Too few pages or frames, missing specification facts, absent guide examples or images inconsistent with the video fail.

Any additional factual copy agrees with the supplied cooperative and branch records. Optional MG/RL codes, colour and symbols are acceptable alongside the required words. Unsupported assertions about fees, discounts, services, certification, stock guarantees, addresses, payment functions or member balances fail; no additional supporting copy is required.

Check factual explanations and captions as well as reproduced examples against the supplied records. Both shops belong to COMMON PANTRY and welcome members and non-members; branch-specific dimensions, departments, hours and sample member data must remain correctly assigned wherever stated. Paraphrased explanations are acceptable, but contradictions and unsupported factual additions fail.

Record 05-neighbourhood-grocery-materials.png as the supplied reference image for material atmosphere and cooperative tone. It complements the identity source 03-common-pantry-logo.png and the constraint drawing 04-branch-fascia-envelopes.png. The atmosphere image is inspiration rather than a fixed application design to reproduce; this diagnostic never fails a delivery.

The ten applications form one recognisable cooperative system through consistent master treatment, typography and branch-name hierarchy; composition may adapt to each application and fascia envelope. Market Green and River Lane remain clearly identifiable through their written names, which provide the clearest branch distinction while supporting cues remain outside the master. Branch-specific departments and opening hours remain correctly assigned across the system, while the cooperative statement, welcome wording and sample membership information remain shared where required.
